toegepas.voor: Party skuilings is natuurlik en ander
toegepas.na: Party skuilings is natuurlik, en ander
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses ('skuilings is' / 'ander is ... gemaak').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both sides of 'en' have their own subject and verb, so the AWS comma is required; meaning unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The lesson refers to an animal as 'hy/hom/sy' elsewhere (hom, sy nes); 'dit' here breaks the pronoun reference.
toegepas.fout: 'dit' can be read as pointing to the nest rather than the animal, and the lesson elsewhere refers to the animal as hy/hom/sy.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'hy' points unambiguously to the animal and matches the lesson's pronoun use; nothing else moves.

toegepas.voor: 'n Skulp word nie gebou soos 'n nes nie maar groei
toegepas.na: 'n Skulp word nie soos 'n nes gebou nie, maar groei
toegepas.rede_vinder: The comparison belongs before the participle inside the negation, and a comma before the contrasting 'maar' makes the sentence easier to read.
toegepas.fout: English-like order with the participle before the comparison, and the fixed 'nie ... nie, maar' construction lacks its comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Natural Afrikaans order puts 'gebou' last inside the negation, and the contrast still says the shell grows rather than being built.

toegepas.voor: Party mense pak die heining van klip en ander van takke met dorings aan.
toegepas.na: Party mense pak die heining van klip, en ander maak dit van takke met dorings.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The split verb 'pak ... aan' reads as 'aanpak' (tackle), and stacking does not suit thorn branches; give the second clause its own verb and the AWS comma.
toegepas.fout: The split verb 'pak ... aan' reads as 'aanpak' and makes a reader stumble at the end of the sentence.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal removes the stumble, keeps stone and thorn branches as the two materials, and adds the required AWS comma between two full clauses.

toegepas.na: staan binne in hul eie hokkies
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'eie' needs a possessive here; 'in eie hokkies' is clipped and unidiomatic.
toegepas.fout: 'in eie hokkies' is clipped and unidiomatic without a possessive.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'in hul eie hokkies' is what a fluent writer would write and says exactly the same.

toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence is a contrast marked by 'wel', so 'maar' fits; two full clauses take the AWS comma.
toegepas.fout: The sentence is a contrast (marked by 'wel') but is joined with 'en', and the two full clauses lack the AWS comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'maar' makes the contrast plain for a Grade 4 reader without changing what is said about either structure.

toegepas.voor: dra iets swaar of dit hou
toegepas.na: dra iets swaars, of dit hou
toegepas.rede_vinder: After 'iets' the adjective takes -s ('iets swaars'), and 'of' joining two full clauses takes the AWS comma.
toegepas.fout: 'iets swaar' lacks the required -s ending after 'iets', and two full clauses joined by 'of' lack the AWS comma.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Plain grammar and punctuation fix in a study block; the protected glossary definition is not touched.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'maak so ook' is awkward; 'vorm op dieselfde manier' says the same thing naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'maak so ook' is awkward and vague.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'vorm op dieselfde manier' says the same comparison naturally and adds no fact.

toegepas.voor: lê teen mekaar en jy kan
toegepas.na: lê teen mekaar, en jy kan
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses ('takke lê' / 'jy kan sien').

toegepas.blok: Nie elke skuiling pas in een groep nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses ('raam hou' / 'planke hou').

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'binnehou' is a compound verb and is written as one word when it is not split.
toegepas.fout: The compound verb 'binnehou' is written apart in a subordinate clause, where it is not split.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Spelling fix only; the meaning is identical.

toegepas.voor: Klip hou jare lank en 'n klipmuur
toegepas.na: Klip hou jare lank, en 'n klipmuur
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses ('Klip hou' / 'klipmuur staan').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Required AWS comma in the list item, adding no words; meaning unchanged.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: More natural word order: the object comes before the place adverb.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'maak dikwels daar hul huis' is already natural Afrikaans order; the proposal is a lateral move.
